title: Assignment Regex Implementation
description:
## What does this MR do?

This MR adds the implementation for generating assignment-like regex programatically for a given vendor pattern. Here's the details:

### Rule Schema Change

We introduce `assignmentContext` property in the `$rule` schema which contains the following properties:

1. `keywordGroup` \<string\> : Comma(`,`) separated keywords to use when combining them into a variable name on the LHS of the assignment-like expression. In addition, this syntax supports two keyword alternatives:
   1. Optional(`?`): Append question-mark(`?`) at the end of the keyword if it is optional, which will create a combination of variable names with and without optional keywords.
   2. One of(`|`): Separate two or more keywords by one-of symbol (`|`) such their combinations are generated. The variable names in the regex are generated in the same order of appearance.
2. `keywordGroupType` \<enum: `raw`/ `multi_case`\>: Indicates whether to inject `keywordGroup` directly as provided, or generate multiple case variant combinations for the left-hand side of the expression. This property is mutually exclusive to `caseVariants`, either one can be defined. This is useful when the combination of keyword alternatives(`?` and `|` ) and case variants go beyond a defined limit, in that scenario, we could use `raw` type to represent a value/regex fitting our usecase.
3. `caseVariants` \<enum: `CONSTANT_CASE`, `snake_case`, `camelCase`, `kebab-case`, `Kebab-Upper-Case`,`PascalCase`, `dot.case`\>: Array of case variants to consider when generating the combination of variable names. The variable names in the regex as placed in same order of the case variants are defined. This is useful when we observe a particular case occurs commonly than others, which improves the performance of the regex.

With the above changes, `rule.regex` property can not contain only the RHS side i.e., vendor pattern in the rule schema. During the rule distribution, this property's value will be replaced by assignment regex pattern.

### Sample

```
[[rule]]
id = "test"
regex = "[a-z]{32}\b"

[rule.assignmentContext]
keywordGroup = "api?,secret,key"
caseVariants = ["CONSTANT_CASE", "snake_case", "camelCase"]
```

Generated Regex:

```
(?:API_SECRET_KEY|api_secret_key|apiSecretKey|SECERT_KEY|secret_key|secretKey).{0,8}[:=].{0,8}([a-z]{32})\b
```

### `AzureAPIManagementDirectKey` rule changes

To realize the above assignment regex feature, I have modified `AzureAPIManagementDirectKey` rule compatible with assignment context changes. The tests are passing.

https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/544937+s

+func TestGenerateRegex(t *testing.T) {
+	testVendorPattern := `[a-f0-9]{32}` // ve
+	capturedVendorPattern := fmt.Sprintf("(%s)", testVendorPattern)
+	scenarios := []struct {
+		scenario         string
+		keywordGroup     string
+		keywordGroupType KeywordGroupType
+		caseVariants     []CaseVariant
+		vendorPattern    string
+		lhsPattern       string
+		keywords         []string
+		error            string
+	}{
+		// Single Alternative Case
+		{
+			scenario:         "basic scenario",
+			keywordGroup:     "gitlab,api,token",
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			lhsPattern: `(?:GITLAB_API_TOKEN|gitlab_api_token|gitlabApiToken|gitlab-api-token|gitlab\.api\.token|GitlabApiToken|Gitlab-Api-Token)` +
+				assignmentOperand +
+				capturedVendorPattern,
+			keywords: []string{"gitlab_api_token", "gitlabapitoken", "gitlab-api-token", "gitlab.api.token"},
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "basic scenario with some cases",
+			keywordGroup:     "gitlab,api0,token",
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     []CaseVariant{ConstantCase, CamelCase},
+			lhsPattern: `(?:GITLAB_API0_TOKEN|gitlabApi0Token)` +
+				assignmentOperand +
+				capturedVendorPattern,
+			keywords: []string{"gitlab_api0_token", "gitlabapi0token"},
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "with optional alternative",
+			keywordGroup:     "api?,token",
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     []CaseVariant{ConstantCase, SnakeCase, PascalCase},
+			lhsPattern: `(?:API_TOKEN|api_token|ApiToken|TOKEN|token|Token)` +
+				assignmentOperand +
+				capturedVendorPattern,
+			keywords: []string{"api_token", "apitoken", "token"},
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "with one-of alternative",
+			keywordGroup:     "api|app,token",
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     []CaseVariant{ConstantCase, SnakeCase, CamelCase},
+			lhsPattern: `(?:API_TOKEN|api_token|apiToken|APP_TOKEN|app_token|appToken)` +
+				assignmentOperand +
+				capturedVendorPattern,
+			keywords: []string{"api_token", "apitoken", "app_token", "apptoken"},
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "with both one-of and optional alternatives",
+			keywordGroup:     "gitlab?,api|app,token",

+			caseVariants:     []CaseVariant{ConstantCase, SnakeCase},
+			lhsPattern: `(?:GITLAB_API_TOKEN|gitlab_api_token|GITLAB_APP_TOKEN|gitlab_app_token|API_TOKEN|api_token|APP_TOKEN|app_token)` +
+				assignmentOperand +
+				capturedVendorPattern,
+			keywords: []string{"gitlab_api_token", "api_token", "gitlab_app_token", "app_token"},
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "with case retention in camel/pascal cases",
+			keywordGroup:     "azure,openAI,token", // we want "AI" in openAI to be retained in camel and pascal cases
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     []CaseVariant{ConstantCase, SnakeCase, CamelCase, PascalCase},
+			lhsPattern: `(?:AZURE_OPENAI_TOKEN|azure_openai_token|azureOpenAIToken|AzureOpenAIToken)` +
+				assignmentOperand +
+				capturedVendorPattern,
+			keywords: []string{"azure_openai_token", "azureopenaitoken"},
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "adds capture group if vendor pattern doesn't have one",
+			keywordGroup:     "azure,openAI,token",
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     []CaseVariant{ConstantCase, SnakeCase, CamelCase, PascalCase},
+			vendorPattern:    `[a-zA-Z0-9]{32}\b`,
+			lhsPattern: fmt.Sprintf(
+				`(?:AZURE_OPENAI_TOKEN|azure_openai_token|azureOpenAIToken|AzureOpenAIToken)%s([a-zA-Z0-9]{32}\b)`,
+				assignmentOperand,
+			),
+			keywords: []string{"azure_openai_token", "azureopenaitoken"},
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "does not capture group if vendor pattern already have one",

+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     []CaseVariant{ConstantCase, SnakeCase, CamelCase, PascalCase},

+			keywords: []string{"azure_openai_token", "azureopenaitoken"},
+		},

+			scenario:         "failure with max combinations - 1",
+			keywordGroup:     "api|app,token",
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     nil, // all cases will lead to 2^alts(1) * all-cases(6) = 12 > max(8)
+			error:            fmt.Sprintf("no of combinations exceed %d combinations, reduce alternatives or case variants", maxCombinations),
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "failure with max combinations - 2",
+			keywordGroup:     "app?,token",
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     nil, // all cases will lead to 2^alts(1) * all-cases(6) = 12 > max(8)
+			error:            fmt.Sprintf("no of combinations exceed %d combinations, reduce alternatives or case variants", maxCombinations),
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "failure with max combinations - 3",
+			keywordGroup:     "app?,key|token",
+			keywordGroupType: MultiCaseKeyword,
+			caseVariants:     []CaseVariant{ConstantCase, SnakeCase, CamelCase}, // all cases will lead to 2^alts(2) * 3 cases = 12 > max(8)
+			error:            fmt.Sprintf("no of combinations exceed %d combinations, reduce alternatives or case variants", maxCombinations),
+		},
+		{
+			scenario:         "raw keyword group type",
+			keywordGroup:     `some[-_]?raw_value`,
+			keywordGroupType: RawKeyword,
+			lhsPattern:       `some[-_]?raw_value` + assignmentOperand + capturedVendorPattern,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, sc := range scenarios {
+		t.Run(sc.scenario, func(t *testing.T) {
+
+			ctx := &AssignmentContext{
+				KeywordGroup:     sc.keywordGroup,
+				KeywordGroupType: sc.keywordGroupType,
+				CaseVariants:     sc.caseVariants,
+			}
+			rhs := testVendorPattern
+			if sc.vendorPattern != "" {
+				rhs = sc.vendorPattern
+			}
+			output, err := ctx.Generate(rhs)
+
+			if sc.error != "" {
+				require.EqualError(t, err, sc.error)
+				return
+			} else {
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+			}
+			require.Equal(t, sc.lhsPattern, output.Pattern)
+			require.ElementsMatch(t, sc.keywords, output.Keywords)
+		})
+	}
+}

+				{oneOf: []string{"token"}, optional: false},

+		{
+			name:         "invalid one-of value",
